text: Owner decision, 19 November 2026 (ADR 005): someone who may discover a release may read its catalog record (title, description, creators, keywords, data types, licence, identifiers). Discovery still shows no file names, participants, per-file metadata, history or other releases. For SHARE1: the sharing dialog must say, before the steward confirms, that a discoverable share shows the study's description. For SEE3: search may match record text for every release the caller may discover.
